selection: Vocadito IDs 1 through 6, first 10 seconds; fixed before inference
averaging: equal-weight macro across six excerpts, separately per condition
scope: These six solo singing excerpts and controlled mixtures; no claim for commercial mixes, choirs, singer identity, calibrated confidence, or training independence. No tuning on benchmark outcomes.
purpose: Development after failed v1; not independent qualification
calibration_selection: Feasible only if all original gates pass; max minimum singing RPA, min maximum singing FA, min backing FA, then higher confidence, source share and RMS thresholds
holdout_selection: First track of each of first six unseen singers scanning numeric IDs after6, selected by metadata only; do not consume holdout without eligible calibration profile
stop_rule: No expanded grid or holdout replacement after outcomes. V1 remains failed. If no candidate passes calibration, do not evaluate holdout.
